summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (loader plus private _resolve_path helper, standard library only), an explicit import in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection in docs/source/data.rst, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Nothing was run: black, flake8, and the tests are unverified. Line lengths were checked by reading and awk (none over 120). Choices: missing image/label fields are skipped silently; base_dir None uses the datalist directory; the loader returns shallow copies of items. No commits were made.
